strings.d1.s0.name: Marienplatz
strings.d1.s0.tips: Glockenspiel at 11:00 (and 12:00, plus 17:00 in summer); the Neues Rathaus tower lift costs 6 EUR.
strings.d1.s1.name: Frauenkirche
strings.d1.s1.tips: Cathedral with twin onion-domed towers; look for the Devil's Footprint.
strings.d1.s2.name: Viktualienmarkt
strings.d1.s2.tips: Food market since 1807; try Weisswurst (tradition says eat it before noon), Obazda and the beer garden.
strings.d1.s3.name: Asamkirche
strings.d1.s4.name: Hofbräuhaus München
strings.d1.s4.tips: Beer hall dating from 1589; Mass of beer, Schweinshaxe (roast pork knuckle) and a brass band, sharing long tables with locals.
strings.d1.b0.name: Augustiner Bräustuben
strings.d1.b0.tips: The brewery's own hall; a local alternative to the Hofbräuhaus.
strings.d1.b1.name: Peterskirche Alter Peter Tower
strings.d1.b1.tips: 306 steps up; views over Marienplatz, an alternative to the Frauenkirche.
strings.d2.s0.name: Munich Residenz
strings.d2.s0.tips: Wittelsbach palace; see the Antiquarium, the treasury and the Cuvilliés Theatre.
strings.d2.s1.name: Hofgarten
strings.d2.s1.tips: Palace garden with a Diana temple.
strings.d2.s2.name: Eisbachwelle
strings.d2.s2.tips: River-wave surfers in the middle of the city, all year round.
strings.d2.s3.name: Chinesischer Turm Biergarten
strings.d2.s3.tips: Beer garden by the Chinese pagoda in the Englischer Garten; you can bring your own food. Try Brezn (pretzel) and Steckerlfisch (grilled fish on a stick).
strings.d2.s4.name: Englischer Garten Monopteros
strings.d2.s4.tips: A winter walk; the Seehaus on the lakeshore and the park under snow.
strings.d2.b0.name: Seehaus im Englischen Garten
strings.d2.b1.name: Alte Pinakothek
strings.d2.b1.tips: Dürer, Rubens, Rembrandt; 1 EUR on Sundays, a good swap for the park when it rains.
strings.d3.s0.name: Nymphenburg Palace
strings.d3.s0.tips: Baroque summer palace; see the Gallery of Beauties and the Amalienburg. The park is free.
strings.d3.s1.name: Nymphenburg Palace Park
strings.d3.s2.name: Schlosscafé im Palmenhaus
strings.d3.s2.tips: Greenhouse café; lunch in the palace park.
strings.d3.s3.name: Olympiapark
strings.d3.s3.tips: The tent roofs of the 1972 Olympics; the Olympiaturm viewing platform costs 13 EUR.
strings.d3.s4.name: BMW Welt and Museum
strings.d3.s4.tips: BMW Welt is free, the museum costs 10 EUR; next to Olympiapark.
strings.d3.b0.name: Olympiaturm Restaurant
strings.d3.b1.name: Pinakothek der Moderne
strings.d3.b1.tips: Modern art and design; an alternative to BMW.
strings.d4.s0.name: Dachau Concentration Camp Memorial
strings.d4.s0.tips: 45 minutes by S2 and bus; memorial at the first concentration camp. Free entry, audio guide 4 EUR. Heavy but necessary.
strings.d4.s1.name: Dachau Altstadt
strings.d4.s1.tips: The town's old quarter and palace garden; a quiet break.
strings.d4.s2.name: Schwabing Leopoldstrasse
strings.d4.s2.tips: Bohemian district with the Siegestor and cafés.
strings.d4.s3.name: Café Luitpold
strings.d4.s3.tips: Coffee house from 1888; try the Prinzregententorte (layered chocolate cake).
strings.d4.s4.name: Glockenbachviertel
strings.d4.s4.tips: LGBTQ+-friendly neighbourhood with bars and Gärtnerplatz.
strings.d4.b0.name: Bratwurstherzl Viktualienmarkt
strings.d4.b0.tips: Nuremberg sausages next to the market.
strings.d4.b1.name: Lenbachhaus
strings.d4.b1.tips: Blaue Reiter (Kandinsky, Marc); an alternative to Schwabing.
strings.d5.s0.name: Neuschwanstein Castle
strings.d5.s0.tips: 2.5 hours by train and bus (Bayern-Ticket) or on a tour. Ludwig's fairy-tale castle; book timed tickets online weeks ahead. The climb takes 30 minutes.
strings.d5.s1.name: Marienbrücke
strings.d5.s1.tips: The bridge with the postcard view of the castle; it may be closed in winter because of ice.
strings.d5.s2.name: Hohenschwangau Castle
strings.d5.s2.tips: Ludwig's childhood castle; combined ticket available.
strings.d5.s3.name: Alpsee Lake Walk
strings.d5.s3.tips: Mountain lake below the castles, with swans.
strings.d5.s4.name: Füssen Altstadt
strings.d5.s4.tips: Medieval town; have Käsespätzle (cheese noodles) before the train back.
strings.d5.b0.name: Schlossrestaurant Neuschwanstein
strings.d5.b1.name: Tegelbergbahn
strings.d5.b1.tips: Cable car to an Alpine summit; an alternative to the lake.
strings.d6.s0.name: Deutsches Museum
strings.d6.s0.tips: The world's largest science museum; mining, aircraft and a planetarium.
strings.d6.s1.name: Isar River Walk
strings.d6.s1.tips: A winter walk along the river.
strings.d6.s2.name: Wirtshaus in der Au
strings.d6.s2.tips: Bavarian restaurant specialising in Knödel (dumplings); in the Au district.
strings.d6.s3.name: Müllersches Volksbad
strings.d6.s3.tips: Art nouveau swimming pool from 1901, with a sauna.
strings.d6.s4.name: Gärtnerplatz
strings.d6.s4.tips: Round square and theatre; come in the evening.
strings.d6.b0.name: Der Pschorr Viktualienmarkt
strings.d6.b0.tips: Bavarian food at the edge of the market.
strings.d6.b1.name: Deutsches Museum Verkehrszentrum
strings.d6.b1.tips: Transport museum; an alternative to the baths.
strings.d7.s0.name: Theresienwiese & Bavaria Statue
strings.d7.s0.tips: Oktoberfest grounds (September–October); views from the head of the Bavaria statue.
strings.d7.s1.name: Augustiner-Keller Biergarten
strings.d7.s1.tips: Chestnut-shaded beer garden seating 5,000; a Mass and Brezn for your farewell.
strings.d7.s2.name: Munich Hauptbahnhof
strings.d7.s2.tips: S-Bahn to the airport takes 40 minutes; time to say goodbye.
strings.d7.b0.name: Marienplatz Dallmayr
strings.d7.b0.tips: Luxury delicatessen and café; good for souvenirs.
strings.d7.b1.name: Alter Botanischer Garten
strings.d7.b1.tips: Park next to the station; an alternative to Theresienwiese.
strings.note0: An MVV day ticket costs about 9 EUR; the S-Bahn to the airport takes 40 minutes. For Neuschwanstein, take the Bayern-Ticket (train and bus) or a tour.
strings.note1: In December there are Christmas markets (Marienplatz, Tollwood); in winter it is around 0°C with snow. The Alps and Neuschwanstein are under snow, and the beer halls are warm.
strings.note2: A Mass of beer costs 15 EUR (16+ at Oktoberfest), Brezn 2 EUR, Schweinshaxe 20 EUR; you can bring your own food to a beer garden. When tipping, round up the bill.
strings.note3: Eat Weisswurst before noon and peel off the skin; it comes with sweet mustard.
strings.note4: Museums cost 1 EUR on Sundays (the Pinakothek galleries); book Neuschwanstein tickets online weeks ahead.
strings.note5: The Dachau memorial is free and open on Mondays; please stay quiet and respectful.
